# Udit Rawat

> AI consultant based in New Delhi. Builds production LLM systems, on-device models, multi-agent tools, and Shopify stores. Taking freelance website and AI enablement projects.

## Services
- AI audits: review of LLM cost, reliability, and evaluation for an existing product
- RAG and support-triage pilots
- LLM cost and routing reviews
- Shopify storefronts with email and Flow automation

## Projects
- [Tribunal](https://uditrawat.dev/work/tribunal/): multi-agent fact-checker with a deterministic citation verifier. 96% quote grounding on a 32-claim golden set.
- [LLM gateway at TapHealth](https://uditrawat.dev/): 85% lower LLM cost on one nudge pipeline after April fixes (private codebase); gateway with ordered fallbacks.
- [Offline diabetes model](https://uditrawat.dev/): quantized Qwen model running fully on a Snapdragon phone at 380 MB.
- [Misaanjh](https://uditrawat.dev/work/misaanjh/): live Shopify storefront with in-house email and Flow automation.
- [Context Lab](https://uditrawat.dev/work/context-lab/): benchmark of repo context strategies, with cost per answer.
- [Glassbox](https://uditrawat.dev/work/glassbox/): GPT built from first principles in PyTorch, with a live attention visualizer.
